This program optimises a smooth soft-max surrogate of the sup-norm (log-sum-exp with increasing sharpness β) via L-BFGS on a squared-parameterisation w↦w², rather than hill-climbing heights directly. It adds Anderson extrapolation on the fixed-point iteration to accelerate convergence, and it anneals β across three stages with repeated rounds per stage. It also seeds from several sine-power bumps…

This program optimises the full autocorrelation ratio directly via Dinkelbach iterations on a square-root variable with a soft-max surrogate for the infinity norm, rather than isolating the level-transition loss and perturbing along its gradient. This program runs its structural surgery at multiple low resolutions (1500 and 3000) rather than a single n_low=2500 round, and it polishes the surgery result with L-BFGS-B every 4 accepts instead of validating only at low resolution.
